parts:
hi all,

I have a plot x-axis ranges from 1-360. By default, the axis
ticks are displayed for only 50,100,150, 250, 300, 350. My question
is : how can I add more ticks to the axis? I want to show ticks and
grid lines for 1,2,3,4,5,...,360.

Thanks a lot!

Tiannan

messages.subject: Re: adjust number of axis tick and grid lines
parts:
I think this is what you are looking for:
m <- qplot(rating, votes, data=subset(movies, votes > 1000), na.rm = T)


m + scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1,3,7,9))

Scott

messages.subject: Re: adjust number of axis tick and grid lines
parts:
Hi Tiannan,

I would seriously question whether 360 gridlines and tick marks is a
good idea It is liable to be difficult to see the individual ones
(unless you have a really big graph). Nevertheless:

require(ggplot2)
dfrm <- data.frame(x = 1:360, y = runif(360))
ggplot(data = dfrm, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
geom_point() +
## I specified the default labels, you could change them
scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:360, labels = 1:360)


Cheers,

Josh
